title: ISBN is unique per tenant
body: Two tenants may stock the same book, so a lookup that omits the tenant can return the wrong row.
summary: Two tenants can stock the same book, so a catalogue lookup must scope by tenant, not by edition alone.
quote: the key that identifies an edition is not unique on its own and is always read together with the tenant it belongs to

title: Search pages hold 50 titles
body: A larger page makes the Postgres full-text query slow enough for a shopper to feel it.
summary: Search result pages are capped at fifty titles so the query stays fast enough to feel instant.
quote: Search results are paginated at fifty titles per page.
